main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: The Christian cross is a key to awakening from the material illusion
header_desc: The meeting of the Condor and the Eagle symbolizes the ultimate union between science and spirituality, allowing us to understand that human consciousness is not a byproduct of matter but a fundamental property of the Universe. It is precisely the Primordial Consciousness that has the mission of reintroducing gnosis, revealing that each cerebral hemisphere is linked to a distinct plane of the cosmos: the timeless and divine corresponds to the pneuma, while the temporal and material belongs to the psyche. This evidences that what Christian tradition defines as the <q>rapture</q> is, in essence, a spiritual awakening known as the <q>Return to Divine Unity</q>.
left_title: The Awakening of Sophia: From the Prison of Yaldabaoth 🧠 to the Kingdom of ONE ❤️
left_body: The Gnostic gospels, written nearly two thousand years ago, hold the key to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity. The EGO has mass and creates the temporal-material illusion of the psyche 🧠; to counteract it, the cosmos offers us a Universal Consciousness, timeless and non-spatial —the ONE—, which allows us to return to the divine timelessness of the pneuma ❤️.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation, frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere —our pneuma— resides the timeless and divine plane; the high-frequency spiritual plane | 999⟩ is the origin of the cosmos where the Invisible Father dwells. There lies the land of unity and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: Consciousness manifests through two fundamental states: the spiritual |ONE⟩ —represented by Pistis Sophia and associated with the right hemisphere ❤️—, and the physical |EGO⟩ —represented by the Demiurge Yaldabaoth and associated with the left hemisphere 🧠—. This shows us that we possess free will of perception, which can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨ONE ❤️|EGO 🧠⟩, reaffirming the maxim <q>The Kingdom of God is within you</q> (Gospel of Thomas, logion 3).
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere resides the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency physical plane | 666⟩; the end of the cosmos where Yaldabaoth dwells. There is a place where: <q>wars are peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: When the Eagle of the North and the Condor of the South fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken, and all of humanity will heal.
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: The Flight of Science and Spirituality
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle { footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)}
cap1_desc: Premise and integration framework: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call to balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and Temporal Illusion { footnotesize color{golddark}(01:13 -- 02:42)}
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, Einstein's break from simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_title: Chapter 3: Consciousness and Space-Time { footnotesize color{golddark}(02:47 -- 05:19)}
cap3_desc: The conceptual assembly Faggin--Segarra: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside of space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free from time and space.
cap4_title: Chapter 4: Gnosis and Material Illusion { footnotesize color{golddark}(05:27 -- 08:39)}
cap4_desc: The discovery of Nag Hammadi (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as home, but as confinement of the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to found a religion of dogmas, but to liberate the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Kingdom of Light and the Prison of the Demiurge { footnotesize color{golddark}(08:43 -- 10:16)}
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth —also known as the great architect of matter— is the creator of the sensible world, an egocentric god ignorant of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres { footnotesize color{golddark}(10:23 -- 14:38)}
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublespeak (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, against the revolutionary message of Jesus that dismantles the imperial system of slavery.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos { footnotesize color{golddark}(14:40 -- 16:30)}
cap7_desc: In the end, the great paradox boils down to this: in the vastness of the cosmos —with its more than two trillion galaxies— it is there that Jesus's phrase resonates most powerfully: «The Father and I are one». Could this have an hidden message about the deep bond between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a white man, bigger than normal, with a flaming beard, sitting in heaven and counting every sparrow's fall, is ridiculous. But if by God one understands the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then such a God clearly exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it doesn't make much sense to pray to the law of gravity.</q>
